title: Kiritani Haruka — Drowning In Dazzlement〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It feels like it's been so long since I last went home at this time.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Until just recently, I often stayed past dark each day to prepare for the School Festival....)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I'm going home at my normal time now... I guess that means it's really over now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I had so much fun too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? An?
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad asked me to go out and buy some stuff. I was just about to head over to the station.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you on your way home, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm going to the station too.
Why don't we head there together?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Actually, I was about to ask you the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had a feeling.
Then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You looked like you had something on your mind just now. Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, not really. I was just reminiscing about all the fun I had during the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
If that's the case, you should be smiling more.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wouldn't it seem a bit strange if I just started laughing to myself in public, even if I was thinking about some fun memories...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know that a certain friend of mine would call out to me soon afterwards because they were worried.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What would you do without me?
Is what I would've said, but I noticed the look on your face after I called out to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly just happened to see you walking by and decided to ask where you were going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we're best friends, but I can't exactly tell how you're feeling just by seeing your back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, you can't? What kind of best friend are you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, Miss Perfect, try telling how I feel just based on my back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I had a ton of fun during the Miya Girls School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Despite getting chased all around campus by a zombie wolf?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gulp*
You know about that too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. You thought I didn't?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember how you dove into my class and left a second later while Kohane was chasing you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I did?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you did. But you were so desperate to get away from the zombie wolf that I didn't get a chance to ask you what was going on.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on. Your class did that animal cafe, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why it seemed so familiar when I went with Kohane and the others later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An... I guess you were genuinely terrified.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, a zombie wolf's completely different from a ghost. Why did it scare you so much?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why?! I mean, that mask...
It looked so real!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I learned beforehand that Kohane's class would be doing a haunted house, so I tried my best to prepare myself mentally for it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't like what I don't like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, how did you prepare yourself for it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well... I tried telling myself that things are gonna jump out at me and that they're people, not monsters...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. However...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It didn't work, did it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Cut me some slack.
I was sure that my plan would work!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Seriously, I wasn't expecting to run into a zombie wolf right off the bat...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess that makes sense...
A surprise like that would throw anyone into a panic.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
I never would've seen that coming!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, it is a haunted house, so that's not really an excuse...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm glad you got to enjoy it in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same. My heart raced because of how scary it was, but I guess that's sorta what haunted houses are all about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I'm glad that I got to enjoy it as an actual haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you try the haunted house at PXL the next time you visit?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's pretty similar to the haunted house that Kohane's class made, so I'm sure you'll be fine, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're joking! That haunted house isn't as scary as I thought it was going to be?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really isn't. You become Phenny as he has a nightmare that's filled with skeletons who keep saying that they're going to “fry you up”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Fry you up?! Like chicken?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not kidding. Some even talked about frying you up like “yummy wings” and “juicy tenders”.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I heard that there's even one that says, “I'm gonna turn you into bang bang chicken!” If you find it, something good's supposed to happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! I've never heard of anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's probably because you usually cover your ears when people talk about this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. True...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The next time we get to go to PXL with Minori and Kohane, we can give the haunted house a try.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, okay! I actually might be okay based on your explanation!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See? Then, let's all go again sometime.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
